title: Priced above category average
prompt: Return the names of products priced above the average price within their own category (nested/correlated subquery).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE prod8 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, price REAL); INSERT INTO prod8 VALUES (1,'A','Hardware',10.0),(2,'B','Hardware',30.0),(3,'C','Toys',5.0),(4,'D','Toys',15.0),(5,'E','Hardware',20.0);
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM prod8 p1 WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM prod8 p2 WHERE p2.category = p1.category);
